source.paper: Shimayoshi T, Takeuchi A, Matsuoka S. Integrative simulation analysis of myocardial ischaemia-reperfusion injury. J Physiol. 2026.

principle: Run original equations unchanged; modify only protocol controls, simulation duration, output path, and selected output variables.

protocols.description: Both source challenge protocols disabled; source equations and initial conditions otherwise unchanged.
Enable only the source respiratory-acidosis protocol: 300 s control, 600 s acidosis, then recovery.
Enable only the native source ischemia protocol: 180 s control, 900 s ischemia, then reperfusion.

fitTarget: source cellular active cross-bridge force Fb (absolute source units retained); normalized ratios are diagnostic derivatives only
primaryWholeHeartBridge: Kato/Utaki/Shim lineage: Fb -> published K_S cell-to-wall scaling -> passive+active wall stress -> LV pressure
